spec: section 3 + section 14 (harness-local supplement; NOT a frozen vector file)
description: Cofactor-class edge inputs for the Monocypher harness: validly-signed inputs that make each section-3 wrapper leg load-bearing, plus the residual mixed-order R/A cases that a cofactored verifier accepts and the cofactorless strict predicate rejects. 'oracle' is the independent pure-Python cofactorless section-3 predicate in gen_supplement.py; 'cofactored_verifier' is what a cofactored, non-canonical-tolerant verifier (the Monocypher core) decides. kind = control-valid (raw and wrapper accept) | wrapper-bites (harness GATES: raw accepts where the oracle rejects, wrapper rejects with exactly oracle_variant) | wrapper-redundant (harness GATES: wrapper rejects with oracle_variant; raw may also reject) | residual-mixed-order (harness REPORTS as KNOWN-DELTA, never fails).
provenance: python3 -I gen_supplement.py; RFC 8032 TEST 1 key; deterministic; id111 verify_strict agreement recorded in test-vectors/monocypher-smoke.md

vectors.name: control: honest RFC 8032 TEST 1 key signs the supplement message
vectors.rationale: positive control: both a strict and a cofactored verifier accept

vectors.name: small-order R (identity), r = 0, S = h*a: equation holds
vectors.rationale: R = identity is small-order; [S]B = [h]A so even the cofactorless equation holds - ONLY the small-order R leg rejects it

vectors.name: non-canonical R alias (y = p + 1) of the identity, r = 0, S = h*a (h over the alias bytes)
vectors.rationale: Monocypher accepts non-canonical R encodings; the canonical-R leg must reject this validly-signed input

vectors.name: order-8 torsion R, S = h*a: holds only after cofactor clearing
vectors.rationale: R is a small-order point of order 8: [8]-cleared equation holds (cofactored accepts); the small-order R leg must reject

vectors.name: honest signature with S replaced by S + l
vectors.rationale: malleability: S + l verifies in a non-S-checking verifier; Monocypher itself already rejects S >= l, so this leg is redundant with the core (recorded, not required to bite)

vectors.name: mixed-order R = [r]B + order-8 torsion, S = r + h*a
vectors.rationale: R is not small-order and canonical; cofactored equation holds, cofactorless fails by exactly the torsion component. dalek verify_strict rejects; a cofactored verifier accepts

vectors.name: mixed-order R = [r]B + order-2 torsion, S = r + h*a
vectors.rationale: R is not small-order and canonical; cofactored equation holds, cofactorless fails by exactly the torsion component. dalek verify_strict rejects; a cofactored verifier accepts

vectors.name: mixed-order A' = A + order-8 torsion (attacker-chosen NodeId), honest signing key a
vectors.rationale: A' is not small-order and canonical; the cofactored equation ignores the torsion part of A', the cofactorless one does not. A NodeId of this shape would verify on a cofactored (Monocypher) node and fail on a dalek verify_strict node
